title: At last, my a 3D game is created, Glowseed Gather
author: Athena_Webb
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/nua0jljm4gxh1.png

This is Glowseed Gather, an arcade game for just one level where you will run around in a small environment collecting shining seeds inspired by the "finish something small" mentality from the Tripo Vibe Gaming Playbook.  
I have created many games that haven't even gone beyond sketching. This time I have set a simple rule; I pick a game feature and never go back to it no matter what. The difficult part has not been getting the skills; it has been figuring out what next steps to take. 

It's early development, so tell me what's broken or what you'd add?
